title: Evaluation, Privacy, and Academic Integrity
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of false positives, source availability, and human review, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in document-plagiarism-checker.
learning_objectives: Explain false positives, source availability, and human review in plain language and connect it to test_app.py; app.py.
Trace one input through the evaluation, privacy, and academic integrity stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: false positives, source availability, and human review
practical_outcomes: Trace the evaluation, privacy, and academic integrity stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for false positives, source availability, and human review.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
